Class View.LabelWithImageAndText

java.lang.Object
Amphipolis.Javadoc.View.LabelWithImageAndText
Direct Known Subclasses:
View.ButtonTilesView, View.InventoryTilesView
Enclosing class:
View
public abstract static class View.LabelWithImageAndText extends Object
Abstract base class for all tile-based views (Inventory, Board, Cards). Manages the common visual logic for displaying an image (or clickable button) alongside a numerical count label.

    • positionCountLabel

      protected void positionCountLabel(int index, int from, int to)
      Positions the count label (e.g., 'x5') relative to the image based on specific index ranges. Used to adjust layout for different rows or sections of the board. Pre-condition: countLabel is initialized. Post-condition: The bounds of countLabel are set relative to x and y.
      Parameters:
      index - The tile's index.
      from - The start of the index range for specific positioning.
      to - The end of the index range.

    • createImageComponent

      protected abstract void createImageComponent()
      Abstract method to create the specific visual component (e.g., a simple Label or an interactive Button). Must be implemented by subclasses. Post-condition: The specific component (imgLabel or button) is instantiated and bounds are set.

    • initializeComponents

      protected void initializeComponents()
      Initializes the UI components. Calls createImageComponent() and configures the text alignment of the count label. Post-condition: Components are ready to be added to a panel.

    • attach

      protected void attach(JPanel panel)
      Attaches the visual components to a standard JPanel. Pre-condition: panel is not null. Post-condition: The image (or button) and the count label are added to the panel.
      Parameters:
      panel - The target container.

    • update

      public void update()
      Updates the image icon and the text of the count label based on the current state. Refreshes the asset from disk based on name. Pre-condition: Assets exist in the "assets/img/" directory. Post-condition: The component displays the correct icon and the text "x[Count]".

    • getCount

      public int getCount()
      Parses the text of the count label to return the integer value. Handles formats like "x5" or "5 / 16". Pre-condition: countLabel contains text. Post-condition: Returns the integer count, or -1 if parsing fails.
      Returns:
      The count of items (or -1 if error).
